Anyone willing to donate some of their excess to a former player?
Send me a message if so and I will arrange shipping.
Thanks for your time.

But since V and CE have been sold out quite long ago Jyhad is the only one still floating around in reasonable numbers. Since people aren't buying it like hot cakes to get PS (I think biggest reason to get Jyhad) I'd say it inät that wanted a card.

But if you have extras I'm sure you wonät have any problems converting them into other cards...
